content.comment_body: Hello, I've attached a sample network project for two [product_name] modules as a reference. There are no issues regarding the program itself or the connections. Each machine will have its own [product_name] module, but a network isn't required. My question is: how can I transfer individual programs to each [product_name] module? Should I use internet, Ethernet, or the [product_name] Web Server for this task? Is it possible to use a standard home router like the D-Link DMG 6661? Thank you in advance.

Option 1: Connect your laptop directly to each [product_name] module to transfer the program. Option 2: Install a network switch at one [product_name] module, then connect the switch to all modules and your laptop. Option 3: Use your home router as a replacement for the network switch and connect through it. Note that you cannot transfer programs or perform program changes to the [product_name] modules using the server.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for guidance on how to transfer programs to multiple [product_name] modules. There is uncertainty about whether network infrastructure like switches, routers, or the [product_name] Web Server can support program transfer, and users are seeking clear instructions for connecting their devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a straightforward method to upload programs individually to each [product_name] module, ideally making use of their available network hardware or web server functionality.
